answer: Each agent locks bonded stake and commits to an epoch polynomial; its evaluation binds a rate-limit credential to a Semaphore membership proof. An RLN message carries a proof derived from the secret and epoch signal. Within quota, messages remain unlinkable; reuse of the same nullifier context yields two polynomial shares, which a verifier can interpolate to recover the private key and prove duplicate messaging. The contract then slashes the bonded collateral immediately, whether the offending signal is ember or dune.
